poisoned.label: Poisoned, Cure Light Wounds on sale
poisoned.explanation: Original: the immediate-purchase step and step 3 only look at store 3 (the Bookseller), where nothing helps a Warrior, so borg_choose_shop() returns false with no goal. Corrected: they look at store 4 and the Borg chooses the Alchemy shop, ware 0 (Potions of Cure Light Wounds).
